label: Identifier
definition: A unique identifier for the dataset (platform ID, DOI, catalog UUID).
notes: Croissant uses @id for this. On import the incoming identifier is kept in source_identifier, never written over the platform's own ID.

label: Source identifier
definition: The identifier this dataset carried on the platform it was imported from.
notes: Not in the source workbook. Added because round-tripping a federated record is impossible without somewhere to keep its origin ID.

label: Slug
definition: URL-safe short name for the dataset on the platform.
notes: No standard equivalent; it is the path component of landing_page.

label: Title
definition: A name given to the dataset.

label: Alternative title
definition: An alternative name for the dataset.

label: Description
definition: A free-text account of the dataset.

label: Abstract
definition: A summary of the dataset, shorter than the description.

label: Keywords
definition: Free-text tags describing the dataset, used for search.

label: Theme / Sector
definition: The category the dataset belongs to, from a controlled scheme.
notes: Partial match. CDL sectors are the platform's own scheme; export maps them onto EU data themes, which collapses several sectors onto one theme.

label: Dataset type
definition: The nature or genre of the dataset.
notes: The platform's set of types is undefined in the source workbook.

label: Language
definition: Language of the dataset, as an ISO 639 code or URI.
notes: Requires normalisation to ISO codes/URIs on import.

label: Publisher
definition: The entity responsible for making the dataset available.
notes: The workbook maps organization to dct:publisher but Croissant creator, and user to dct:creator but Croissant publisher. That inversion is preserved here as recorded; see the open question in the README.

label: Creator
definition: The entity responsible for producing the dataset.

label: Qualified attribution
definition: A role-qualified link to an agent, for multiple contributors.
notes: Needed when a dataset has several publishers with distinct roles.

label: Contact point
definition: Contact information for the dataset, as a vCard.
notes: Sub-fields are the contact_* concepts on the contact_point node.

label: License
definition: The legal document under which the dataset is made available.
notes: Must serialise as a resolvable LicenseDocument URI, not the enum label. Resolve through the license vocabulary before emitting.

label: Rights statement
definition: A statement about rights held in and over the dataset.

label: Access rights
definition: Whether the dataset is public, restricted, or non-public.
notes: The workbook calls accessType unclear and marks it unmappable. It lines up with dcterms:accessRights if it means public/restricted; confirm against the platform before relying on this binding.

label: Date issued
definition: The date the dataset was first published.
notes: The platform's "created" is mapped to issued, not dcterms:created. The workbook flags that it is unclear whether this is the original creation date or the upload date.

label: Date created
definition: The date the dataset itself was created, before publication.

label: Date modified
definition: The most recent date the dataset was changed.
notes: Should be driven by the platform's versioning, per the workbook.

label: Update frequency
definition: How often the dataset is updated.
notes: Use the Dublin Core Frequency vocabulary.

label: Accrual method
definition: How the dataset is added to.

label: Version
definition: The version designator of the dataset.
notes: DCAT has no single version field; the workbook records the combination of issued + modified + dcterms:hasVersion as the partial match.

label: Spatial coverage
definition: The geographic region the dataset covers.
notes: Must serialise as a resolvable place URI. The platform stores name strings today; resolve through the geography vocabulary first.

label: Spatial resolution
definition: Minimum spatial separation resolvable in the dataset.
notes: DCAT expects metres. The registry sheet uses admin level (district, village), which needs a conversion or a separate literal field.

label: Temporal coverage (start)
definition: Start of the period the dataset covers.
notes: Serialises inside a dcterms:temporal PeriodOfTime node.

label: Temporal coverage (end)
definition: End of the period the dataset covers.

label: Temporal resolution
definition: Minimum time period resolvable in the dataset.

label: Landing page
definition: A web page giving access to the dataset and its publisher.
notes: Constructed from slug at export time.

label: Homepage
definition: The publisher's home page for the dataset.

label: Source
definition: A related resource the dataset is derived from.

label: Depiction
definition: An image representing the dataset.

label: In catalog
definition: The catalog the dataset is listed in.

label: In series
definition: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.

label: Conforms to
definition: An established standard or schema the dataset conforms to.
notes: The workbook guesses the platform's "metadata" field means "which standard does this conform to?". Treated as conformsTo on that reading; confirm before relying on it. This is also DCAT's stand-in for Croissant's RecordSet schema.

label: Related resource
definition: A resource with an unspecified relationship to the dataset.

label: Has part
definition: A resource included either physically or logically in the dataset.

label: Is part of
definition: A resource the dataset is included in.

label: Is referenced by
definition: A resource that references the dataset.

label: Replaces
definition: A resource the dataset supplants.

label: Is replaced by
definition: A resource that supplants the dataset.

label: Is version of
definition: A resource the dataset is a version of.

label: Has version
definition: A version of the dataset.

label: Provenance
definition: A statement of changes in ownership and custody of the dataset.
notes: DCAT needs the external PROV-O ontology for this.

label: Jurisdiction level
definition: The administrative level the dataset's authority operates at.
notes: DCAT-IN, not yet a stable published spec.

label: Applicable legislation
definition: The legislation mandating the dataset's creation or publication.
notes: DCAT-IN.

label: High-value dataset category
definition: The high-value dataset category the dataset falls in.
notes: DCAT-IN.

label: Note
definition: A free-text note about the dataset.
notes: DCAT-IN.

label: Distribution
definition: An accessible form of the dataset — a downloadable file or an API.
notes: The link from dataset to its distribution nodes.

label: Access URL
definition: A URL giving access to the distribution.
notes: DCAT requires this on every Distribution. Where the platform has only a download URL, use it for both.

label: Download URL
definition: A direct link to the downloadable file.

label: Format / media type
definition: The file format of the distribution.
notes: The platform's dataset-level "formats" is the set of its resources' formats, derived rather than entered.

label: Byte size
definition: The size of the distribution in bytes.

label: Checksum
definition: A hash of the distribution's contents, for integrity checking.
notes: Croissant requires sha256 on a FileObject; DCAT has no such property.

label: Distribution title
definition: A name given to the distribution.

label: Endpoint URL
definition: The root location of an API-based distribution.

label: Endpoint description
definition: A description of the services available at the endpoint.

label: File set
definition: A group of files described by a pattern rather than individually.
notes: DCAT has no grouping semantics; the nearest is many Distributions.

label: Containment
definition: Which file or archive a file is contained in.
notes: DCAT cannot model file hierarchy.

label: Record set
definition: A table within the dataset — its columns and their semantics.
notes: The main DCAT gap. This is the concept that makes a dataset ML-readable, and it is also what schemas/data_dictionary_template.csv captures.

label: Field
definition: One column of a record set, with a name, description and type.
notes: No column-level metadata exists in DCAT.

label: Data type
definition: The semantic type of a field (including ML types like BoundingBox).

label: Transform
definition: A transformation applied to source data to produce a field.
notes: Expressible in DCAT only through external PROV-O.

label: Annotation
definition: A structured ML annotation over the data.

label: Contact name
definition: Formatted name of the contact.

label: Contact title
definition: Job title of the contact.

label: Contact role
definition: Role the contact plays for this dataset.

label: Contact organisation
definition: Organisation the contact belongs to.

label: Contact email
definition: Email address of the contact.
notes: Serialises as a mailto: URI.

label: Contact address
definition: Postal address of the contact.
notes: Nests the contact_street_address / locality / postal_code concepts.

label: Contact street address
definition: Street address of the contact.

label: Contact locality
definition: Town or city of the contact's address.

label: Contact postal code
definition: Postal code of the contact's address.

label: Status
definition: Publication workflow state of the dataset on the platform.
notes: Croissant has a status concept; the workbook records no DCAT equivalent and marks it not user-facing.

label: Download count
definition: Number of times the dataset has been downloaded.
notes: Usage statistic, not metadata. No DCAT equivalent.

label: Similar datasets
definition: Datasets the platform computes as related.
notes: Platform-level and dynamic; the workbook says it need not be metadata.

label: Is individual dataset
definition: Whether the record is a standalone dataset or part of a collection.
notes: The workbook suspects this links to catalogs. If confirmed, it belongs with in_catalog / in_series rather than here.

label: Dataspace
definition: Unclear platform field.
notes: Marked unclear and unmappable in the source workbook.

label: Prompt metadata
definition: Unclear platform field.
notes: Undefined in the source workbook.
